title: 跨部門溝通
description: 與其他部門協調合作的用語

sentences.en: I would like to schedule a meeting with the marketing department to align our product launch timeline with their promotional campaign.
sentences.zh: 我想跟行銷部門安排一場會議，以將我們的產品上市時程與他們的促銷活動對齊。

sentences.en: Could you please coordinate with the design team to ensure that the user interface mockups are consistent with our brand guidelines?
sentences.zh: 你能否與設計團隊協調，確保使用者介面原型圖與我們的品牌指南一致？

sentences.en: The engineering team has raised concerns about the feasibility of the timeline proposed by the sales department, which seems overly aggressive.
sentences.zh: 工程團隊對業務部門提出的時程表示擔憂，認為它似乎過於緊迫。

sentences.en: After consulting with the legal department, we determined that the contract terms need to be revised before we can proceed with the partnership.
sentences.zh: 在與法務部門諮詢後，我們確定合約條款需要修改才能繼續推進合作關係。

sentences.en: I need to escalate this issue to the operations team, as it involves infrastructure changes that fall outside our department's scope of responsibility.
sentences.zh: 我需要將這個問題升級到營運團隊，因為它涉及超出我們部門職責範圍的基礎設施變更。

sentences.en: The finance department has requested that all cross-departmental projects submit a detailed budget proposal by the end of this quarter.
sentences.zh: 財務部門要求所有跨部門專案在本季結束前提交詳細的預算提案。

sentences.en: To avoid miscommunication between our teams, I suggest we establish a shared documentation system where updates can be tracked transparently.
sentences.zh: 為了避免我們團隊之間的溝通不良，我建議建立一個共享的文件系統，讓更新可以被透明地追蹤。

sentences.en: The quality assurance team identified several critical bugs that need to be addressed before the development team can release the next version.
sentences.zh: 品質保證團隊發現了幾個嚴重的錯誤，需要在開發團隊發布下一版本之前解決。

sentences.en: I have been working closely with the customer support department to gather user feedback that will inform our next product iteration.
sentences.zh: 我一直與客戶支援部門密切合作，收集將為我們下一次產品迭代提供資訊的用戶回饋。

sentences.en: Since this initiative spans multiple departments, we should appoint a dedicated project coordinator who can facilitate communication and track deliverables.
sentences.zh: 由於這項計畫跨越多個部門，我們應該指派一位專責的專案協調人來促進溝通和追蹤交付成果。

sentences.en: The HR department informed us that the new cross-departmental training program will begin next month and requires participation from all teams.
sentences.zh: 人資部門通知我們，新的跨部門培訓計畫將於下個月開始，需要所有團隊的參與。

sentences.en: I appreciate your team's willingness to accommodate our request, especially given the tight deadline and the additional workload it creates.
sentences.zh: 我很感謝貴團隊願意配合我們的要求，特別是考慮到緊迫的期限和它所增加的工作量。

sentences.en: Before we proceed with the implementation, I need written confirmation from the compliance department that our approach meets all regulatory requirements.
sentences.zh: 在我們繼續實施之前，我需要合規部門的書面確認，證明我們的方法符合所有監管要求。

sentences.en: The data analytics team has prepared a comprehensive report that highlights areas where interdepartmental collaboration could be significantly improved.
sentences.zh: 數據分析團隊準備了一份全面的報告，強調了跨部門合作可以顯著改善的領域。

sentences.en: We encountered a bottleneck because the procurement department was not informed about the urgent need for additional server capacity.
sentences.zh: 我們遇到了瓶頸，因為採購部門沒有被告知對額外伺服器容量的緊急需求。

sentences.en: I suggest we hold a weekly sync meeting with representatives from each involved department to ensure everyone stays informed about project progress.
sentences.zh: 我建議我們每週與各相關部門的代表舉行同步會議，確保每個人都了解專案進度。

sentences.en: The research and development team has shared their prototype with us, and we need to provide feedback within the next three business days.
sentences.zh: 研發團隊已經與我們分享了他們的原型，我們需要在接下來的三個工作日內提供回饋。

sentences.en: Our department's objectives for this quarter are closely tied to the deliverables expected from the supply chain management team.
sentences.zh: 我們部門本季的目標與供應鏈管理團隊預期的交付成果密切相關。

sentences.en: I want to acknowledge the outstanding support we received from the IT department during the system migration, which went remarkably smoothly.
sentences.zh: 我想感謝資訊部門在系統遷移期間給予我們的出色支援，整個過程進行得非常順利。

sentences.en: The cross-functional task force, which includes members from five different departments, will present their findings at the next all-hands meeting.
sentences.zh: 包含來自五個不同部門成員的跨職能工作小組，將在下次全體會議上報告他們的發現。

sentences.en: Could you clarify which department is ultimately responsible for approving the budget allocation for this joint initiative between engineering and marketing?
sentences.zh: 您能否釐清哪個部門最終負責批准工程和行銷之間這項聯合計畫的預算分配？

sentences.en: We need to resolve the conflicting priorities between our department and the sales team before the situation escalates further and affects customer deliveries.
sentences.zh: 我們需要在情況進一步升級並影響客戶交付之前，解決我們部門和業務團隊之間的優先順序衝突。

sentences.en: The project manager suggested that we create a shared Kanban board so that all departments involved can visualize the workflow and identify dependencies.
sentences.zh: 專案經理建議我們建立一個共享的看板，讓所有相關部門都能視覺化工作流程並識別依賴關係。

sentences.en: I reached out to the logistics department yesterday, and they confirmed that the shipment delay will not impact our production schedule significantly.
sentences.zh: 我昨天聯繫了物流部門，他們確認出貨延遲不會對我們的生產計畫產生重大影響。

sentences.en: In order to streamline the approval process, we proposed that each department designate a single point of contact for cross-team communications.
sentences.zh: 為了簡化審批流程，我們建議每個部門指定一位跨團隊溝通的單一聯絡窗口。

sentences.en: The collaboration between our engineering team and the external vendor's support staff has been extremely productive over the past few months.
sentences.zh: 在過去幾個月中，我們工程團隊與外部供應商支援人員之間的合作非常有成效。

sentences.en: I would appreciate it if your department could provide us with the data we requested by Thursday, as our analysis depends on its timely availability.
sentences.zh: 如果貴部門能在週四前提供我們要求的數據，我會很感激，因為我們的分析取決於它的及時供應。

sentences.en: The CEO emphasized during the town hall that breaking down silos between departments is a top priority for achieving our annual strategic objectives.
sentences.zh: 執行長在全員大會上強調，打破部門之間的壁壘是實現我們年度策略目標的首要任務。

sentences.en: We need to establish clear ownership and accountability for each phase of the project to prevent confusion when multiple departments are contributing simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 我們需要為專案的每個階段建立明確的負責人和問責制，以防止多個部門同時貢獻時產生混淆。

sentences.en: After the reorganization, our team will report to the technology division instead of operations, which may change how we interact with other departments.
sentences.zh: 重組後，我們的團隊將向技術部門而非營運部門彙報，這可能會改變我們與其他部門互動的方式。
